title: RGB Outline Selection
description: This mod only changes the outline selection of the block from black to RGB (animated)
body:
# 🌈 RGB Outline Block Selection [Fabric]

> A sleek, lightweight client-side Minecraft mod that replaces the dull, default block selection outline with smooth, dynamic animated RGB edges. 

Designed to maintain a vanilla feel while providing a more modern and colorful block highlight, it only changes the visual outline effect. It does not add unnecessary systems, heavy rendering features, or additional gameplay mechanics, ensuring the performance impact remains minimal and perfectly suitable for everyday gameplay.

### ✨ Features
* **Smooth RGB Animations:** Modernize your crosshair targeting with colorful transitions.
* **Zero Dependencies:** Completely **STANDALONE**. Fabric API is NOT required!
* **Vanilla-Friendly:** Keeps the core game mechanics and aesthetic completely untouched.
* **Ultra-Lightweight:** Minimal performance impact, perfect for everyday gameplay, potato PCs, or heavy modpacks.
* **Client-Side Only:** Safe to use on any multiplayer server.

---

### 🛠️ Latest Changelog
* **[BUG FIX]** Fixed the rendering glitch that occurred when players activated the vanilla **High Contrast Block Outline** option in Minecraft's accessibility settings. Enjoy seamless RGB rendering even with high contrast enabled!
